entries.58f778c8efc9602d: Manufacture and sale of rice balls. Products include "Onigiri Q" and "Funwari Omusubi", and frozen rice balls are also sold in Hong Kong. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥18,873 million.
entries.7029c543cbaeca27: Manufacture and sale of sushi, including pack sushi and hand-rolled sushi. One of the company's main products since its founding. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥3,934 million.
entries.8f06bcc3679449df: The group's sole reportable segment, a business that manufactures and wholesales bento boxes, rice balls, cooked breads, sushi, prepared foods, frozen foods and others. Products are manufactured at 8 factories, the Osaka Factory, Kansai Factory, Keiji Factory, Nagoya Factory, Chiba Factory, Okayama Factory, Hiroshima Factory and Shikoku Factory, for convenience stores, supermarkets, drugstores and others. Consolidated subsidiaries are 2 companies: S.F.D. Co., Ltd., which leases real estate, and Maitsu Bekarī Co., Ltd., which purchases and sells raw materials. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥61,974 million, the same as consolidated revenue.
entries.9b4f416bdbbe1735: Manufacture and sale of cooked breads and sandwiches. Products include the sandwich "epi mou" and others. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥9,838 million.
entries.9b5485fe381f1abc: Manufacture and sale of bento boxes. In addition to chilled bento under the brand "Mana Gokoro Bento", it also sells frozen bento under the brand KOKORO. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥21,291 million, the largest by product category.
entries.c08c48095fcff546: Food manufacturing and wholesale sales business
entries.d705b7d572ce3ac4: A food manufacturer that produces boxed lunches, rice balls, prepared sandwiches and bread, sushi, side dishes, and frozen foods, and sells them wholesale to convenience stores, supermarkets, and others.
entries.f0f6bd5ccccadddc: Sale of prepared foods and other products, and of purchased goods. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥7,155 million for other products and ¥881 million for purchased goods.
